{{Top}}
'''Jatz''' was a genre of [[Music/Legends|music]] popular in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], however, jatz was considered "turgid" and outdated compared to the more modern genre of [[leap-jump]]. Jatz experienced a revival under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], however, largely owing to the efforts of [[Fitz Roi]]. [[Jizz/Legends|Jizz]] was a similarly named music genre.
